notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 directed-interaction subscription kinds. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies object-class and directed-interaction publication, by-ownership and universal subscriptions, registered target routing, delivery identity and metadata, unsubscription, and standard cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador object-class directed-interaction publication, by-ownership/universal subscription, targeted send, unsubscription, resignation, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador discovery and receiveDirectedInteraction callbacks
